title: Increase Repulsion Gain
statement: Increasing the repulsion gain will make the robot more responsive to obstacles, reducing the likelihood of collisions.
mechanism: The repulsion gain affects how strongly the robot avoids obstacles. A higher gain means the robot will steer away from obstacles more quickly and aggressively.
contradicting_evidence: Experiment plan_7ff77fec: Observed delta=+0.000. Verdict: inconclusive (No statistically significant difference in collision count or success rate.). (Did not produce statistically distinguishable change)
